All 96 tests pass. The implementation is complete.

**Summary of changes:**

- **`communityApi.ts`** — Added `deleteCommunityNote` function
- **`CommunityPage.tsx`** — Major notes section overhaul:
  - Extended `NoteDraft` type with `color`, `pinned`, `tags`, `_key`, `updatedAt`
  - Added `activeNoteKey`, `noteQuery`, `noteTab`, `noteSaveStatus`, `deleteConfirmKey`, color picker/tag input state, plus refs for title/body/save-timer
  - Auto-save via 800ms debounce (replaces manual "保存笔记" button), ⌘B/⌘I/⌘S keyboard shortcuts
  - Replaced notes JSX with: note list panel (search + 全部/置顶/标签 tabs + pinned/unpinned card groups) + editor panel (format toolbar + serif title + date/tags row + body + status bar with word count + delete)
  - Delete shows a confirmation overlay; on confirm, removes from state and calls `deleteNoteMutation`
- **`communityPage.test.tsx`** — Updated 2 tests to use ⌘S instead of the removed "保存笔记" button
